gpu: one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q GPU

metric_population.failure_policy: failed or contract-invalid responses retain sanitized timing and metadata but are excluded from performance distributions

timestamp_precision: nanosecond-unix-fields; ISO labels are second precision

timing_methodology.artifact_timestamps: time.time_ns Unix timestamps; independent artifacts may align them only when the operator supplied the same explicit clock_domain_id
timing_methodology.controlled_output: --response-words adherence is recorded; observe preserves historical behavior while strict rejects non-exact or truncated completions; visible response capture is capped at 8192 characters
timing_methodology.decode: usage completion tokens after the first token divided by client-observed generation time; completion tokens may include reasoning tokens
timing_methodology.distributions: request-level mean, sample standard deviation, normal-approximation 95% confidence interval for the mean, min, p25, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99, and max using the nearest-rank percentile method
timing_methodology.effective_prefill: usage.prompt_tokens divided by client-observed time to first output; includes queueing, scheduling, prefill, and first-token work
timing_methodology.generation: client-observed E2E minus time to first output
timing_methodology.p99: numeric nearest-rank p99 is always retained for compatibility; it is descriptive only below 100 eligible samples
timing_methodology.request_canaries: when enabled, each response must begin with its own synthetic marker and contain no other ANVIL_REQ marker; bounded/truncated captures fail closed and are excluded from performance metrics
timing_methodology.time_to_first_output: request start through the first non-empty streamed reasoning or content delta
timing_methodology.tpot: client-observed mean time per output token after the first output; identical to the legacy mean_inter_token_latency key
timing_methodology.ttft: request start through the first non-empty streamed content delta
